title: Spicy Mexican Pot Fondue
description: A spicy twist on the classic fondue, this Mexican-inspired dish is perfect for a fun and interactive meal. Serve with tortilla chips or veggies.
instructions: Heat the pot cheese in the fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the Indian korma paste and stir until combined.
Add the mustard seeds and stir for 1 minute.
Add the velvety hot sauce and stir until heated through.
Serve the fondue in the fondue pot with tortilla chips or veggies.
For an added kick, sprinkle some diced jalapenos on top of the fondue.
